text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer! Check out that amusement
park ad!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Get the scare of your life at our
haunted
mansion!" That place looks gas!
We've gotta go
check it out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No cap, I'm so curious about what they
mean with
the whole "now with 300%
more monsters" thing!
Thump, thump, thump!
choice_data_list: すごそうではあるけど……

text_block_list.name: Horde of Zombies
text_block_list.text: Rwaaahhh! Braaains... BRAAAIIINSSS!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! Did they seriously mob us with a
horde of
zombies right off the bat?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's get outta here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! That was, like, the best! There
were so
many zombies at the end, it was
like being
squashed on the morning rush
hour train!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Since we've gone through hell, how
about we
see what paradise is like next?
Everyone online's
been obsessed about
this one ride!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's called "Heaven," and it's apparently
the
scariest roller coaster in history! Even
the heiress
of a big-name company gave
it two thumbs up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clack, clack, clack, clack, clack...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! We're so high up! The view is
total fire!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! True... We're almost at the top
now... Here
we go... Here we go!
choice_data_list: これから落ちるけどなっ……！
これから落ちるけどねっ……！
choice_data_list_en: Though I'm gonna fall right now...!
Though I'm about to drop right now...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO! AWESOOOME!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, I gotta get souvenirs for my
squad, my
classmates, and some of the
younger students...
Oh, I should get
something for the academy's
staff, too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man, I have way too many people to get
gifts for!
I don't even know if I can carry
them all back with
me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait, are you being for real?
choice_data_list: 俺と手分けして持とう！
私と手分けして持とう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's split them up and carry them together!
Let's split it up and carry it together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I'll take you up on that, then.
Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't we get matching
souvenirs while
we're at it? We came
here together, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer and I explore the park
until it gets
dark.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, we made it! We're sure to get a
clear
view of the fireworks from here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it just? I heard about this secret
spot online!
Getting here was a real
pain, but we've got this
whole area to
ourselves!
choice_data_list_en: Seems like a nice little hidden gem.
Seems like a nice little hidden gem.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Peeeeew... BANG!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoooa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That was, like, right over us! Aw, it's a
heart! It's
so close too! Doesn't it feel
like you could just
reach up and grab it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Siiigh... This is seriously so lit! Nothing beats fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think? Are you feeling the
vibes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I knew you'd enjoy yourself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, last time we hung out, you said
nothing
made you happier than seeing
me enjoy myself,
remember?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
When you said that, it reminded me of
the time I
ran my second tryout.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And thanks, Trainer, for giving me that
push I
needed. And from here on I just
gotta keep...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Raisin' the roof and stuff! Waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You've always been there for me, ever
since the
beginning. You're the best
partner anyone could
ask for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You mean a lot to me, so I didn't want to
be a
burden to you. But I was wrong
when I assumed
you'd find me too much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The reality is, you respect my wild and
excited
self just the way I am.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's why you always let me have my
way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, okay, but like! I'm usually the one giving other people support and stuff, so it's weird being the one getting so much support!
choice_data_list: トレーナー冥利に尽きるよ
choice_data_list_en: Nothing could be more rewarding for a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm not used to having someone to lean
on, so
this whole situation's thrown me
for a loop or
three!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But yeah. Thanks. Thanks for being there
for me.
I'm so glad we met!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oop, now you've said it! No take-backs,
though!
You'd better not regret it when I
send you running
errands for me left and
right!
choice_data_list: もっと甘えていいくらいだよ
寄り添い合い、支え合っていこう！
こちらこそ、ありがとう
choice_data_list_en: You can lean on me even more, you know.
Let's stay close and support one another!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ooh, you know what?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You should tell me about your troubles
too
whenever something is weighing on
your mind!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're always so considerate of my
feelings, so I
wanna be just as
considerate to you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer is positively beaming at
me. I swear
then and there to continue
being her strongest
pillar of strength
and support.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Heck yeah, I'm on board with that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There's something special about
knowing
someone always has your back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You can count on me whenever you
need help
too, so don't hold back, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer is positively beaming at
me. I swear
then and there to continue
being her strongest
pillar of strength
and support.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I don't think I did anything worthy
of
getting thanked for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Is that what you meant? But
y'know, it's
thanks to you that I feel
comfortable with being
so open.
choice_data_list: パーマーのことがもっとわかって嬉しいから
choice_data_list_en: Because I'm glad I understand Palmer a little better.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's why I should be the one thanking you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But we'll never finish thanking each
other at this
rate, so let's just call it
even! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer is positively beaming at
me. I swear
then and there to continue
being her strongest
pillar of strength
and support.
